title: A listing file: what `kontra publish <listing.yaml>` sends to the operator's control plane (D323)
description: How one of the publisher's A2A services is sold, as Kontra Cloud's PUT /v1/services/{name} takes it (kontra-cloud D-M5-95, D-M5-110): its visibility, sealing and price, in USD. Listings are A2A only: an MCP service is not listed, and the control plane refuses a listing for one (D350). The file is YAML (or JSON); the price keys are ext-escrow.md's. The CLI checks the file against this schema and sends it; the control plane decides what it accepts, and the gate holds no price.

service.description: The service's name at the gate, under the publisher's tenant: 1 to 63 of [a-z0-9-], not starting or ending with '-'.

visibility.description: public: listed and searched; unlisted: reachable by its URL, never searched (relay.md §12.2, D321); private: the publisher's own tenant only.

published.description: false unpublishes the service (the gate answers it as unknown) and keeps the listing as a new version.

cents.description: USD above 0 with at most 2 decimals: a task is charged in cents.
